metadata.title: hyperCAD-S Assembly Operations - Complete Enumeration
metadata.description: Exhaustive parameter catalog for hyperCAD-S Assembly workspace. Assemblies in hyperCAD are flat (single-level by default) with optional sub-assembly nesting; the focus is on fixturing layouts and multi-part jobs for hyperMILL machining rather than full PDM-grade kinematic chains. Catalog covers: 4 component ops (Insert / Replace / Edit-In-Place / Fix), 1 joint op (with 6 joint kinematics — rigid/revolute/slider/cylindrical/planar/ball), 2 pattern ops (Component-Pattern / Component-Mirror), 4 visibility ops (Hide / Show-Only / Suppress / Group), 1 tree-navigation op, and 3 analysis ops (BOM / Mass-Properties / Interference-Check).
metadata.source: OPEN MIND hyperCAD-S Assembly Reference, hyperMILL Multi-Part Machining Guide

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across hyperCAD-S assembly operations

INSERT_COMPONENT.description: Insert a part / sub-assembly into the active assembly. Component is referenced (linked) by default; optional embed-on-insert breaks the link.

parameters.name: Source Path
parameters.description: Absolute path to part / sub-assembly file

parameters.name: Configuration
parameters.description: Configuration name when source has multiple

parameters.name: Placement Origin
parameters.description: World-coordinate insertion point

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: Reference plane / face / axis system to align component frame to (defaults to world)

parameters.name: Auto Mate To Selected
parameters.description: If selected reference is a face, auto-create planar mate

parameters.name: Component Name
parameters.description: Display name in component tree (defaults to source filename)

parameters.name: Quantity
parameters.description: Multi-instance count (creates linked siblings rather than copies)

REPLACE_COMPONENT.description: Replace an existing component with a different source while preserving its mates / joints when geometry references are still resolvable.

EDIT_IN_PLACE.description: Open a component for editing within the assembly context (parent assembly is visible but not editable). Used for top-down design where component sketches reference parent assembly geometry.

parameters.name: Hide Other Components
parameters.description: Hide siblings during in-place edit for clarity

parameters.name: Allow External References
parameters.description: Permit sketches in this component to reference parent assembly geometry

parameters.name: Lock Other Components
parameters.description: Prevent accidental edits to siblings during edit-in-place

FIX_COMPONENT.description: Fix (ground) a component — remove all degrees of freedom relative to assembly origin. Mandatory on at least one component per assembly.

parameters.name: Fix Relative To
parameters.description: Optional reference frame (defaults to assembly origin)

JOINT.description: Create a kinematic joint between two components. Six standard joint types covering machinist/fixture-design needs from rigid bolt-up through spherical pivot.

parameters.name: Reference A
parameters.description: Edge / face / origin point on Component A defining the joint frame

parameters.name: Primary Axis
parameters.description: Rotation / translation axis (revolute / slider / cylindrical)

parameters.name: Translation Limit
parameters.description: {min, max} mm bounds (slider / cylindrical)

parameters.name: Rotation Limit
parameters.description: {min, max} deg bounds (revolute / cylindrical / ball)

parameters.name: Lock Joint
parameters.description: Temporarily fix the joint at its current pose without removing it

COMPONENT_PATTERN.description: Pattern (instance) a component along a linear / circular / sketch / path layout. Patterned instances are linked siblings.

parameters.name: Direction 1
parameters.description: Edge / axis / vector (linear / along_path)

parameters.name: Spacing 1
parameters.description: Distance between instances (linear / along_path)

parameters.name: Count 1
parameters.description: Total instances incl. seed

parameters.name: Axis
parameters.description: Rotation axis (circular)

parameters.name: Total Angle
parameters.description: Spread of circular pattern

parameters.name: Suppressed Instances
parameters.description: Pattern indices to skip

COMPONENT_MIRROR.description: Mirror components about a plane. Mirrored instances are linked siblings unless 'Create New Components' is set.

parameters.name: Create New Components
parameters.description: Mirror produces handed copies (left/right parts) rather than linked instances

parameters.name: Suffix For New Components
parameters.description: Suffix added to mirrored copy name (Create New Components = true)

HIDE_COMPONENT.description: Hide a component in the active viewport. Component remains in component tree and contributes to mass / interference. Display-only operation.

parameters.name: Cascade To Children
parameters.description: Hide all sub-components recursively

SHOW_ONLY.description: Show only the selected components, hiding the remainder of the assembly. Inverse of HIDE_COMPONENT — useful for isolating one component for hyperMILL setup.

parameters.name: Include Ancestors
parameters.description: Also show parent assemblies of target

parameters.name: Include Descendants
parameters.description: Also show sub-components of target

SUPPRESS_COMPONENT.description: Suppress a component — remove it from rebuild graph entirely. Suppressed components do NOT contribute to mass / interference / BOM, unlike hidden components.

parameters.name: Reason Tag
parameters.description: Optional audit string explaining why component is suppressed (e.g. 'work-in-progress')

GROUP_COMPONENTS.description: Bundle selected components into a logical group within the component tree. Group is purely organizational — no kinematic effect.

parameters.name: Group Color
parameters.description: Optional display color (hex / named) for component-tree highlighting

COMPONENT_TREE.description: Read-only diagnostic — return the component-tree topology with parent / child relationships, suppression flags, and mate counts. Foundation for downstream BOM and audit operations.

parameters.name: Root Component
parameters.description: Optional sub-tree root (defaults to assembly root)

parameters.name: Max Depth
parameters.description: Cap recursion depth (0 = unlimited)

BOM_EXTRACT.description: Extract a Bill of Materials from the assembly. Aggregates linked-instance counts, applies configuration overrides, and exports per-row metadata for ERP / quoting handoff.

parameters.name: Root Component
parameters.description: Optional sub-assembly root

parameters.name: Custom Fields
parameters.description: Per-component metadata fields to include (e.g. material, finish, vendor)

parameters.name: Output Path
parameters.description: File path for csv / excel output

MASS_PROPERTIES.description: Compute mass / center-of-gravity / inertia tensor for the assembly. Honors per-component material density overrides and excludes suppressed components.

parameters.name: Target Components
parameters.description: Empty selection = whole assembly

parameters.name: Selected Axis System
parameters.description: Custom frame (Reference Frame = selected_axis_system)

parameters.name: Density Override
parameters.description: Per-component material density override map

INTERFERENCE_CHECK.description: Detect interferences (overlapping volumes) and clearance violations between components. Required QA gate before fixture / multi-part hyperMILL job submission.

parameters.name: Target Components
parameters.description: Empty selection = pairwise check across whole assembly

parameters.name: Minimum Clearance
parameters.description: Required clearance distance (Mode = clearance_check / both)

parameters.name: Tolerance
parameters.description: Distances under this count as touching, not interfering

platform_notes.linked_vs_embedded: Linked components track source-file changes; embedded components are independent copies. Default linked is preferred for production workflows.
platform_notes.fixture_design: Typical fixture-design workflow: INSERT_COMPONENT (workpiece) → FIX_COMPONENT → INSERT_COMPONENT (fixture parts) → JOINT (rigid mates) → INTERFERENCE_CHECK before sending to hyperMILL.
platform_notes.hide_vs_suppress: HIDE = visibility-only, component still in mass/BOM/interference. SUPPRESS = removed from rebuild, drops from all analyses. Use HIDE for review clarity, SUPPRESS for what-if studies.
